name: Oyster Mushroom
siboNotes: Oyster mushrooms are one of the few low-FODMAP mushroom varieties. Most other mushrooms (button, cremini, portobello, shiitake) are high in polyols. Canned mushrooms and oyster mushrooms are the safe options.
preparationTips: Sauté with garlic-infused oil for flavor
Don't wash - wipe clean with damp cloth
